text:
mira.k: Heads up — bringing up llamaX-4b-int4 on canary pool. Preliminary evals show ~6-8% drop on reprompt robustness (paraphrase cases). Need promptset/sampling adjustments + quick labeling pass.

jon.s: saw the run. Is this a quantization delta or something with batching? numbers? :mag:

mira.k: likely quant noise around per-channel scales on key projections. microbench shows slight logits shift and some truncation on long contexts. harness: https://redwood.internal/evals/llamaX-4b/int4/244321 (private)

akiko: can we validate with float16 baseline on same seeds? also try `--kv-cache=false` to rule out kv-cache masking interactions.

ravi.p: I'll spin float16 + int8 + int4 on the same splits. also proposing a canary set for behavioral checks — 300 prompts total: 50 instruction-follow, 50 multi-turn, 50 code, 50 rewrite, 100 reprompt-adversarial.

mira.k: agree. source split: 100 from prod error logs (last 7 days), 100 stratified from prompt-bank by topic, 100 synthetic paraphrase adversaries.

labeling-bot: label-assignment: canary-set-244321 created. 5 labelers assigned: @akiko, @ravi.p, @jon.s, @mira.k, @tara.l

jon.s: I'll check embedding-based dedupe — current threshold cosine>=0.92. For this canary recommend lowering to 0.88 to keep harder paraphrases.

akiko: For human eval, use pairwise A/B on top-5 outputs and add a "consistency on repeat prompt" question. Labelers: mark regression type dropdown (hallucination / brevity / format / correctness).

ravi.p: Running runs now. ETA ~40m for float16, ~25m for int4 on canary cluster. Will post perf and 99th-latency — watch the tail.

deploy-bot: Run started by ravi.p: jobs/id=run-244321-a (float16), run-244321-b (int4).

mira.k: If regression confirmed, try two interventions: (1) per-layer activation clamp patch (PR #3421), (2) slight sampling temp bump on int4 outputs for smoothing. Prefer try clamp first.

jon.s: Also add quick code-task metric (BLEU / exact-match) — some regressions don't show in LM-specific scores.

labeling-bot: Label batch update: 28/300 completed. Quick note from @tara.l: several prompts get truncated outputs under int4. :rotating_light:

akiko: Good catch. please capture runtime traces for those cases: set `RUNTIME_DEBUG=1` on canary jobs and attach `tail.log`.

ravi.p: Float16 baseline finished — passes. Int4 partial shows mean correctness -7%, 99th-latency +30ms when batching=auto. CSV uploaded: https://redwood.s3/internal/int4_canary_244321.csv

mira.k: Thanks. Let's huddle in 30m to triage and decide clamp PR vs rollback to int8. Quick sync Slack huddle @11:15 — ping if you want to join earlier. :eyes:
